response.query: Which specific social-desirability mitigation tools will we adopt (list experiments, indirect questions, third-party reports, behavioral proxies) and how will we pre-register manipulation checks?
response.answer: We will adopt indirect questions, behavioral proxies, and third-party reports to mitigate social desirability. Manipulation checks will be pre-registered in the study protocol.
